parties: Varun Beverages Limited (parent, India-listed) / Bevco (The Beverage Company Proprietary Limited, South Africa subsidiary) / Twizza Proprietary Limited (South Africa step-down subsidiary)
headline: Varun Beverages: Twizza–Bevco merger completed in South Africa; Twizza ceases to be step-down subsidiary
sum: Varun Beverages Limited has completed the merger of its South African step-down subsidiary Twizza into its holding company Bevco, effectively consolidating its South African beverage operations and eliminating Twizza's subsidiary status within the group structure.
implication: The completion signals regulatory approval from South African authorities (likely CIPC) and removes dual-layer subsidiary governance in the South African jurisdiction; VBL's Indian holding structure now simplifies to direct Bevco ownership, reducing reporting complexity for consolidated financials and transfer pricing review.
detail: The Board of Bevco and Twizza had approved the merger on 2 July 2026, subject to South African law compliance. The merger has now been consummated as of 17 August 2026. Twizza, previously a step-down subsidiary (Twizza held by Bevco, held by VBL), has been merged into Bevco, and Twizza no longer exists as a separate entity. This restructuring simplifies VBL's South African holding architecture. The disclosure was made under SEBI Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements Regulations 2015, Reg 30 with Schedule III Part A.

framework.note: Central: governs the merger of Twizza into Bevco; requires compliance with merger procedures, creditor protection, and CIPC registration of merger completion.

framework.note: Relevant: VBL's India-to-South Africa holding structure remains ODI; merger does not trigger capital repatriation but affects subsidiary declaration.

Relevant: Indian accounting standard for VBL's consolidation; elimination of Twizza as separate reporting entity effective from merger completion date.
